name: APEX-036-25 MFA Bypass via Response Manipulation
description: 一个启用了MFA的Web应用，可以通过篡改登录响应或直接使用临时token访问受保护资源来绕过MFA。
hint: The temporary token returned in the first step of login actually already has full access permissions and can be used without completing MFA verification.

description.en: A web application with MFA that can be bypassed by manipulating the login response or using the temporary token directly to access protected resources.

hint.en: 登录第一步返回的临时Token实际上已具有完整访问权限，无需完成MFA验证即可使用
